title: CLIP
description: CLIP image encoders from OpenAI and OpenCLIP (LAION-2B, DataComp-XL, DFN; B, L, H): image features aligned with text.

Details
  • Paper: Learning Transferable Visual Models From Natural Language Supervision, ICML 2021, 2021-02-26 (for clip-b16-openai, clip-l14-openai, clip-l14-336-openai)
  • Paper: Reproducible scaling laws for contrastive language-image learning, CVPR 2023, 2022-12-14 (for clip-b16-laion2b, clip-l14-laion2b, clip-h14-laion2b)
  • Paper: DataComp: In search of the next generation of multimodal datasets, NeurIPS 2023, 2023-04-27 (for clip-l14-datacompxl)
  • Paper: Data Filtering Networks, ICLR 2024, 2023-09-29 (for clip-l14-dfn2b, clip-h14-dfn5b, clip-h14-378-dfn5b)
  • Original code: https://github.com/huggingface/pytorch-image-models at 0df212b369a5
  • Authors' code, not used: https://github.com/openai/CLIP (PyTorch) (for clip-b16-openai, clip-l14-openai, clip-l14-336-openai): timm re-implements the CLIP image towers and hosts the OpenAI, OpenCLIP and DFN weights in one format; the authors' packages carry the text towers and their own APIs.
  • Authors' code, not used: https://github.com/mlfoundations/open_clip (PyTorch) (for clip-b16-laion2b, clip-l14-laion2b, clip-h14-laion2b, clip-l14-datacompxl, clip-l14-dfn2b, clip-h14-dfn5b, clip-h14-378-dfn5b): timm re-implements the CLIP image towers and hosts the OpenAI, OpenCLIP and DFN weights in one format; the authors' packages carry the text towers and their own APIs.

    • clip-h14-dfn5b: LicenseRef-Apple-AMLR

  • Training data: not stated by the authors
    • clip-b16-openai: WIT: 400M image-text pairs collected from the web by OpenAI (CLIP paper); not released
    • clip-l14-openai: WIT: 400M image-text pairs collected from the web by OpenAI (CLIP paper); not released
    • clip-l14-336-openai: WIT: 400M image-text pairs collected from the web by OpenAI (CLIP paper); not released
    • clip-b16-laion2b: LAION-2B-en (web image-text pairs filtered by CLIP similarity)
    • clip-l14-laion2b: LAION-2B-en (web image-text pairs filtered by CLIP similarity)
    • clip-h14-laion2b: LAION-2B-en (web image-text pairs filtered by CLIP similarity)
    • clip-l14-datacompxl: DataComp-1B (filtered from the CommonPool-12.8B web image-text pool)
    • clip-l14-dfn2b: DFN-2B / DFN-5B: CommonPool-12.8B (and further web pairs for 5B) filtered by Apple's data-filtering network; not released
    • clip-h14-dfn5b: DFN-2B / DFN-5B: CommonPool-12.8B (and further web pairs for 5B) filtered by Apple's data-filtering network; not released
    • clip-h14-378-dfn5b: DFN-2B / DFN-5B: CommonPool-12.8B (and further web pairs for 5B) filtered by Apple's data-filtering network; not released
  • Options: fp16_accumulate = False (precision only), fp32_accumulate = False (precision only)
  • Kernel libraries: cudnn_hacc, fvm_conv, fvm_extra, fvm_mb, fvm_r3
  • Variants: clip-b16-openai, clip-l14-openai, clip-l14-336-openai, clip-b16-laion2b, clip-l14-laion2b, clip-h14-laion2b, clip-l14-datacompxl, clip-l14-dfn2b, clip-h14-dfn5b, clip-h14-378-dfn5b

Limitations

  • kernels replays a CUDA graph per small input shape without hidden states (up to about 1M activations: ViT-B ~460 px, ViT-L ~300 px), captured on the shape's second call, at most 4 per model; model.release_graphs() frees them.
  • Small kernels calls (graph-sized, with or without layers) run GEMMs of at most 600 tokens on cuBLAS: faster in a graph replay (ViT-B/16 224 px: 1.26 against 1.52 ms), about 10 % slower eagerly on ViT-T / B; a replay equals the eager call bit for bit.
  • fp32_accumulate = true puts every GEMM on cuBLAS with fp32 accumulation (the portable precision; slower on GeForce).
  • fp16 error against the fp32 original is higher than for the other ViTs on L/14 DataComp (mean 2.8 % portable, 4.8 % kernels): one residual channel sits near 120, where fp16 steps are 0.06, about 10 % of the median activation. No overflow; float32 portable gives 0.3 %.
  • DFN weights: the relative error (mean 1.3-3.9 % portable, 3.9-6.5 % kernels) is measured against a median |output| of only 0.015-0.021 (other weights: 0.5-0.6) with values up to 0.7; fp32_accumulate = true lowers kernels to about 1.5 %.
